name: Blob Feast
hook: Eat smaller blobs. Split to catch them.
how: Your blob drifts toward the pointer. Eat pellets to grow, and swallow any blob a quarter smaller than you. Split in two to lunge at one, then your pieces merge back after a few seconds.
controls: Mouse or drag to move, Space or the Split button to split
uses: Each player's biggest mass, shown when you get eaten.
Bots fill the arena until enough people join.
Every blob moves for everyone at once; whoever gets eaten tells the eater.
ideas: Add spiky mines that pop big blobs
Make it space, with planets eating moons
Add teams with a team score at the top
